about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Combining a deep passion for software engineering, network infrastructure, and technology education.
about.p1: I am a **Software Developer** and **IT Enthusiast** holding a Bachelor of Computer Science in Informatics from Universitas Hayam Wuruk Perbanas Surabaya (2026). I have a strong commitment to crafting digital solutions that are robust, clean, and scalable.
about.p2: My journey in technology spans beyond just writing code—it encompasses a grounded understanding of **network infrastructure, Linux server administration, Cisco/MikroTik routing & switching**, and database engineering. This holistic perspective enables me to build resilient web architectures from ground up.
about.p3: Beyond technical engineering, I dedicate time as a **Coding & Computational Thinking Instructor** for primary school students. This role continuously sharpens my interpersonal communication, patience, empathy, and ability to break down complex technical paradigms into intuitive concepts.

projects.title: Selected Projects
projects.subtitle: A showcase of real-world applications and digital solutions I have architected and deployed.

erapor.title: Religious Studies & Quran E-Rapor – SD Patra Dharma 3 Balikpapan
erapor.short_desc: A production web-based information system managing Quranic memorization evaluations, religious scores, and automatic standardized report card generation.
erapor.full_desc: A production-grade web application deployed for SD Patra Dharma 3 Balikpapan. Built to eliminate manual inefficiencies in compiling tahfidz scores and Islamic studies evaluations. Features a clean, teacher-friendly interface, grade level management, automated cumulative metric calculations, and automated PDF export for official school report cards.
features: Automated tahfidz scoring engine tracking student chapter (juz) and verse memorization progress.
Role-based access control: Administrators, Religion Subject Teachers, and Homeroom Teachers.
Dynamic generation and export of formatted, print-ready PDF grade reports.
Optimized relational schema preserving multi-semester student historical records.

ar_routing.title: Augmented Reality Routing Learning Application
ar_routing.short_desc: An innovative educational AR app visualizing computer network routing mechanisms and physical network hardware in interactive 3D.
ar_routing.full_desc: An interactive pedagogical tool bridging theoretical computer networking with Augmented Reality. Designed to demystify abstract networking concepts—such as packet hops, routing tables, and physical topology—by projecting 3D interactive models into physical space via smartphone cameras.
features: Realistic 3D representations of enterprise routers, switches, and patch cords.
Animated packet forwarding simulation demonstrating path selection from source to destination.
Interactive marker tracking illustrating algorithm flowcharts for best-path selection.
Integrated in-app quiz assessing students' comprehension of routing protocols.

school_scheduling.title: School Scheduling Management System
school_scheduling.short_desc: An integrated scheduling management platform featuring automated constraint verification to prevent teacher and classroom conflicts.
school_scheduling.full_desc: A web solution addressing the combinatorial complexity of academic timetabling. Integrates a conflict-detection engine verifying teacher schedules, specialized laboratory availability, and maximum weekly teaching hour limits.
features: Real-time conflict detection alerting against overlapping teacher assignments.
Comprehensive workload management per subject and classroom capacity allocations.
Exportable weekly schedule matrix in print-ready PDF and Excel spreadsheets.
Intuitive dashboard providing high-level school timetable analytics.

network_lab.title: Networking & Server Laboratory Environment
network_lab.short_desc: Design and deployment of an educational network lab: MikroTik/Cisco routers, subnetting, VLAN segmentation, and localized Linux server setups.
network_lab.full_desc: A comprehensive network architecture engineered for laboratory computing. Encompasses IP address schema planning, VLAN isolation between students and faculty, firewall filtering, fair-use bandwidth queuing, and local Linux server deployment for practical labs.
features: Isolated network segmentation utilizing 802.1Q Virtual LANs (VLAN).
DHCP Server, DNS Caching, and NAT Gateway configuration on RouterOS.
Bandwidth queuing and queue-tree prioritization ensuring fair bandwidth distribution across hosts.
Hardened local Linux server deployment for intranet application testing.
